name: Realism presets — anti-AI-look
note: Each preset supplies the four blocks that decide whether an image reads as a photograph or as 'an AI image': capture (body + lens + exposure), light (source, size, direction, falloff), grade (colour response), and texture (skin, grain, micro-detail). The suppression block is appended to every preset — it is written as positive photographic instruction rather than a negative list, because instruction-following image models handle 'matte skin with visible pores' far better than 'no plastic skin'.

suppression.skin: real skin texture at pore level, visible fine lines at the outer eye and nasolabial fold, faint uneven pigmentation, a few small natural blemishes and moles left in place, matte finish with sebum shine only on the nose bridge and forehead, vellus hair catching the light along the jaw
suppression.symmetry: natural facial asymmetry preserved — the two sides of the face are not mirrored, one eyelid sits marginally lower, the smile pulls slightly further on one side
suppression.hair: individual flyaway strands escaping the hairline, hair not sculpted or airbrushed into a single mass
suppression.colour: neutral colour grading, accurate white balance, restrained saturation, skin tone rendered as it would be on a calibrated monitor rather than warmed for effect
suppression.light: one dominant light source with physically consistent shadow direction and soft natural falloff, catchlights matching the size and position of that source
suppression.optics: moderate depth of field appropriate to the stated aperture, background separation from distance rather than from a synthetic blur, no glow bloom around edges
suppression.grade_discipline: no teal-and-orange split tone, no HDR local contrast, no clarity or structure slider, no vignette added in post
suppression.retouch_discipline: unretouched straight-out-of-camera frame, no frequency-separation smoothing, no eye or teeth whitening, no face slimming, no beauty filter
suppression.output: a photograph, not an illustration, render, or 3D character

presets.name: Estudio softbox neutro
presets.recommended_for: Group A — identity core. The default for the six face-lock frames.
presets.capture: full-frame mirrorless body at 1/250s, ISO 200, RAW converted with a neutral profile — use the lens and aperture given in the SHOT block above
presets.light: one 120cm octabox as key at 45° camera-left and slightly above eye level, a single white bounce card at camera-right for a two-thirds-stop lift, no hair light, no rim
presets.grade: neutral grade, daylight white balance at 5500K, contrast curve close to linear, blacks lifted a touch to a soft charcoal rather than crushed
presets.texture: fine natural sensor grain retained, no noise reduction on skin
presets.background: seamless mid-grey paper, evenly lit, two stops under the subject

presets.name: Luz de ventana natural
presets.recommended_for: Lifestyle, off-duty and seated frames. The most forgiving preset — hardest to make look synthetic.
presets.capture: full-frame mirrorless body at 1/160s, ISO 400 — use the lens and aperture given in the SHOT block above
presets.light: large north-facing window as the only source, camera-left, subject one metre in from the glass, the far side of the face falling into open shade with no fill
presets.grade: cool-neutral white balance around 6000K, gentle S-curve, highlights held well below clipping
presets.texture: visible grain from the higher ISO, natural micro-contrast
presets.background: real interior, softly out of focus from distance not from a filter

presets.name: Documental, luz disponible
presets.recommended_for: Work and lifestyle frames shot inside a real environment.
presets.capture: full-frame mirrorless body at 1/125s, ISO 800, handheld — use the lens and aperture given in the SHOT block above
presets.light: the room's own practical lights plus whatever daylight reaches it, mixed colour temperature left uncorrected the way a real reportage frame would be
presets.grade: documentary grade, slightly muted saturation, mildly warm shadows from the tungsten practicals, no colour separation applied in post
presets.texture: ISO 800 grain, a hint of motion softness in the extremities, imperfect focus plane
presets.background: the working environment itself, cluttered and real

presets.name: Editorial limpio
presets.recommended_for: Full-height and turnaround frames where the silhouette must read cleanly.
presets.capture: full-frame mirrorless body at 1/200s, ISO 100 — use the lens and aperture given in the SHOT block above
presets.light: two large diffusion panels at 45° either side for near-shadowless even coverage across the full figure, key one stop over fill
presets.grade: clean neutral grade, true-to-life skin tone, no warming filter
presets.texture: high-resolution detail in fabric weave and skin, no smoothing
presets.background: seamless light-grey cyclorama lit evenly floor to ceiling

presets.name: Hora dorada contenida
presets.recommended_for: At most one or two frames. Use sparingly — warm low sun is the fastest route back to the AI look if overdone.
presets.capture: full-frame mirrorless body at 1/500s, ISO 100 — use the lens and aperture given in the SHOT block above
presets.light: low sun behind and to one side, a large white bounce returning soft light to the face, warm edge on the hair kept subtle and physically plausible
presets.grade: warm but disciplined — the warmth lives in the light itself, not in the grade; skin tone stays neutral, saturation held at natural levels
presets.texture: fine grain, slight veiling flare from the low sun where it is optically justified
presets.background: exterior, compressed and thrown out of focus by the long lens

presets.name: UGC de móvil
presets.recommended_for: Optional swap for the lifestyle frames when the avatar's end use is social/UGC content rather than brand film.
presets.capture: captured on a modern smartphone main camera INSTEAD of the lens named in the SHOT block — 26mm equivalent at f/1.8, computational HDR left at its default, slight barrel distortion at the frame edge
presets.light: ordinary room light, whatever is available, no professional modifiers
presets.grade: the phone's own default processing — mild contrast, mild saturation, aggressive-but-natural noise handling
presets.texture: phone-sensor detail, faint smearing in the shadow areas, the look of a real casual photo
